MenuRoot.description: Holds the menu's open state and shares it with the parts inside it. Renders no element.

props.open: Whether the menu is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control the menu.
props.defaultOpen: Whether the menu is open at first, when it isn't controlled.
props.onOpenChange: Called with the new state after the browser or a part opened or closed the menu, and in a menubar whenever the bar opens or closes it (including moving to it with the arrow keys). Escape and a press outside can't be refused: a controlled menu that keeps `open` true is shown again. It is called in a change of its own, after the menu's: a request it starts, or a handler that is itself an action, doesn't hold the menu.
props.disabled: A disabled menu doesn't open, and its trigger is disabled.

MenuTrigger.description: The button that opens and closes the menu. Its `popovertarget` keeps a press on it from counting as a press outside the open menu; the press itself is handled by the menu. Enter, Space and ArrowDown open the menu on its first item, ArrowUp on its last.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the menu is open.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the menu is disabled.

MenuPopup.description: The menu: an element with `popover="auto"` and the `menu` role, placed against the trigger with CSS anchor positioning. A submenu's popup is declared inside its parent's. Style it with `:popover-open` and `@starting-style`.

props.side: Which side of the trigger the popup sits on. The browser flips it when it doesn't fit.
props.align: Which edge of the trigger the popup lines up with, along the side.
props.sideOffset: The gap between the trigger and the popup, in pixels.
props.alignOffset: How far the popup is moved along the trigger's edge from its `align` position, in pixels.

dataAttributes.data-side: Which side of the trigger the popup is on: the `side` asked for, then the side the browser placed it on once open.

MenuArrow.description: An element placed on the popup's edge that faces the trigger, centred on the trigger. It follows the popup when the browser flips it. Give it a shape in CSS and turn it per `data-side`.

dataAttributes.data-side: Which side of the trigger the popup is on. Absent while the menu is closed.

MenuItem.description: An action in the menu. Choosing it with a press, Enter or Space runs its `onClick` and, by default, closes the menu.

props.disabled: A disabled item can't be chosen, and the arrow keys skip it.
props.closeOnClick: Whether choosing the item closes the menu and every menu it is nested in.

dataAttributes.data-highlighted: Present while the item has the highlight: it has focus, from the keyboard or from the pointer moving over it.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the item is disabled.

MenuLinkItem.description: A menu item that is a link. Enter follows it.

props.closeOnClick: Whether following the link closes the menu. Off by default, since the page usually changes anyway.

dataAttributes.data-highlighted: Present while the item has the highlight.

MenuCheckboxItem.description: An item that toggles a setting on and off, with the `menuitemcheckbox` role. Choosing it leaves the menu open by default.

props.checked: Whether the item is checked. Pass it with `onCheckedChange` to control it.
props.defaultChecked: Whether the item is checked at first, when it isn't controlled.
props.onCheckedChange: Called with the new state when the item is chosen. It is called in a change of its own, after the item's: a request it starts, or a handler that is itself an action, doesn't hold the menu.
props.disabled: A disabled item can't be chosen, and the arrow keys skip it.
props.closeOnClick: Whether choosing the item closes the menu.

dataAttributes.data-checked: Present when the item is checked.
dataAttributes.data-unchecked: Present when the item is not checked.
dataAttributes.data-highlighted: Present while the item has the highlight.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the item is disabled.

MenuRadioGroup.description: Groups radio items and holds which one is chosen.

props.value: The value of the chosen item. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the group.
props.defaultValue: The value chosen at first, when the group isn't controlled.
props.onValueChange: Called with the item's value when a radio item is chosen. It is called in a change of its own, after the group's: a request it starts, or a handler that is itself an action, doesn't hold the menu.

MenuRadioItem.description: An item that chooses one value of its radio group, with the `menuitemradio` role. Choosing it leaves the menu open by default.

props.value: The value the item stands for in its group.
props.disabled: A disabled item can't be chosen, and the arrow keys skip it.
props.closeOnClick: Whether choosing the item closes the menu.

dataAttributes.data-checked: Present when the item is the group's chosen one.
dataAttributes.data-unchecked: Present when another item, or none, is chosen.
dataAttributes.data-highlighted: Present while the item has the highlight.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the item is disabled.

MenuGroup.description: Groups related items. A `MenuGroupLabel` inside it names the group.

MenuGroupLabel.description: A label for its group: the group's `aria-labelledby` points at it. It isn't an item, so the keyboard skips it.

MenuSeparator.description: A line between items or groups, with the `separator` role.

MenuSubmenuRoot.description: A menu inside a menu. It holds a `MenuSubmenuTrigger`, which is an item of the parent menu, and the submenu's own `MenuPopup`, declared inside the parent's popup. Renders no element.

props.open: Whether the submenu is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it.
props.defaultOpen: Whether the submenu is open at first, when it isn't controlled.
props.onOpenChange: Called with the new state when the submenu opens or closes, including when the browser closes it with its parent. It is called in a change of its own, after the submenu's: a request it starts, or a handler that is itself an action, doesn't hold the submenu.
props.disabled: A disabled submenu doesn't open. It is also disabled when its parent menu is.

MenuSubmenuTrigger.description: The item of the parent menu that opens the submenu: on hover after a delay, on a press, and on ArrowRight, Enter and Space, which also move focus into it. Render it as a `<button>`, as the part does.

props.disabled: A disabled trigger doesn't open its submenu, and the arrow keys skip it.
props.openOnHover: Whether resting the pointer on the trigger opens the submenu.
props.delay: How long the pointer rests on the trigger before the submenu opens, in milliseconds.
props.closeDelay: How long after the pointer leaves, other than towards the submenu, before the submenu closes, in milliseconds.

dataAttributes.data-popup-open: Present while the submenu is open.
dataAttributes.data-highlighted: Present while the trigger has the highlight.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the trigger is disabled.
